title: Tessl Release Roundup - March 12th, 2026
description:
Tessl's latest updates are transforming the way you work with skills. Now you can install skills globally, making them accessible across all your projects without disrupting your team's workflow. No more juggling context across repositories. It's seamless, efficient, and just a single command away. 

Dru Knox, head of Product at Tessl, guides you through these groundbreaking features, diving into how they enhance your existing processes. With his expertise, Dru explains the strengths behind global installs, watch mode, GitHub badges, and a unified score, ensuring you understand their real-world impact.

What we cover:
• How to install skills globally for use across projects
• Automatically sync changes with the new watch local flag
• Embed eval scores as GitHub badges for confidence building
• What does the new single aggregate score mean for your skills?

More info CLI command reference: https://docs.tessl.io/reference/cli-commands#tessl-install
